mutations.name: evidence at any head counts
mutations.find: WHERE repo = ? AND head = ? AND gate = ?
mutations.replace: WHERE repo = ? AND (head = ? OR 1) AND gate = ?
kills: a lan-gates hold cleared by gate evidence stays held when every gate is green only at a head the PR has moved past

mutations.name: a red record counts as green
kills: a lan-gates hold cleared by gate evidence stays held when the newest record for one gate at the head is red, even after an earlier green one

mutations.name: one green gate is enough
kills: a lan-gates hold cleared by gate evidence stays held while one named gate has no record at the head

mutations.name: green evidence never clears
kills: a lan-gates hold cleared by gate evidence stands aside at the PR's exact head once every named gate is green there, without lifting the hold

mutations.name: green evidence lifts the hold for good
kills: a lan-gates hold cleared by gate evidence holds again at a head pushed after the gates went green at the old one

mutations.name: a named reviewer is passed over
kills: a lan-gates hold cleared by gate evidence stays held when the hold names a reviewer, whose verdict it waits for
